question: Why does Week 2A treat sensibility as crucial to metaphysics rather than as something metaphysics can ignore? Answer in 1-3 sentences.
model_answer: Because objects must be given in intuition before understanding can think them. If nothing is given in intuition, there is no object for thought to be about. That is why the conditions of intuition matter for metaphysics.
key_points: Because objects must be given in intuition before understanding can think them
If nothing is given in intuition, there is no object for thought to be about. That is why the conditions of intuition matter for metaphysics
it prevents the common mistake of treating metaphysics as detached from the conditions of possible experience
related_info: If nothing is given in intuition, there is no object for thought to be about. That is why the conditions of intuition matter for metaphysics.
why_high_yield: High yield because it prevents the common mistake of treating metaphysics as detached from the conditions of possible experience.
source_refs: HUMA2831_Week2_02092026_Slides.pdf - slide 10 on the object of metaphysics and intuition
